mainEntity.name: How do I choose an AEO provider for my med spa in New York City?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO provider for your med spa in New York City, look for an agency with proven experience in the aesthetic or medical industry. Prioritize providers who demonstrate a deep understanding of local search trends and patient needs specific to NYC. Inquire about their content strategy, keyword research methodologies, and ability to track and report on specific AEO metrics like featured snippet appearances. Also, ensure they can showcase case studies or client testimonials relevant to med spas.
